WITH recovered AS (
  UPDATE public.leads
  SET
    retry_count =
      retry_count + 1,

    status =
      CASE
        WHEN retry_count + 1 >=
          {{ $('config').first().json.maxRetries }}
        THEN 'audit_failed'
        ELSE 'enriched'
      END,

    failure_reason =
      CASE
        WHEN retry_count + 1 >=
          {{ $('config').first().json.maxRetries }}
        THEN
          'Audit timed out after 20 minutes; retry limit reached'
        ELSE
          'Recovered stale audit; retry scheduled'
      END,

    updated_at = NOW()

  WHERE status = 'auditing'
    AND updated_at <
      NOW() - INTERVAL '20 minutes'

  RETURNING status
)

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS recovered_count,

  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE status = 'audit_failed'
  ) AS terminal_failed_count

FROM recovered;

WITH picked AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.leads
  WHERE status = 'enriched'
    AND email IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(email) <> ''
    AND retry_count <
      {{ $('config').first().json.maxRetries }}
  ORDER BY
    enriched_at ASC NULLS LAST,
    created_at ASC
  LIMIT
    {{ $('config').first().json.batchSize }}
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)

UPDATE public.leads AS lead
SET
  status = 'auditing',
  failure_reason = NULL,
  updated_at = NOW()

FROM picked
WHERE lead.id = picked.id

RETURNING
  lead.id,
  lead.business_name,
  lead.category,
  lead.city,
  COALESCE(lead.state, '') AS state,
  COALESCE(lead.country, 'US') AS country,
  lead.website_url,
  COALESCE(lead.email, '') AS email,

  COALESCE(lead.facebook_url, '') AS facebook_url,
  COALESCE(lead.instagram_url, '') AS instagram_url,
  COALESCE(lead.linkedin_url, '') AS linkedin_url,
  COALESCE(lead.twitter_url, '') AS twitter_url,

  lead.rating,
  lead.review_count,
  lead.campaign_id,
  lead.retry_count,

  lead.pagespeed_mobile,
  lead.pagespeed_desktop,
  lead.pagespeed_score,
  lead.seo_score,
  lead.mobile_score,

  COALESCE(
    lead.performance_json,
    '{}'::jsonb
  ) AS performance_json,

  COALESCE(
    lead.pain_points,
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS enrichment_pain_points,

  COALESCE(
    lead.scraped_html,
    ''
  ) AS scraped_html,

  COALESCE(
    lead.crawl_metadata,
    '{}'::jsonb
  ) AS crawl_metadata,

  COALESCE(
    lead.pages_crawled,
    0
  ) AS pages_crawled;

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
  workflow_name,
  run_at,
  leads_processed,
  leads_failed,
  duration_ms,
  notes
) VALUES (
  'audit_and_draft',
  NOW(),
  0,
  0,
  0,
  'no enriched leads with email in queue'
);

UPDATE public.leads
SET
  retry_count =
    retry_count + 1,

  failure_reason =
    '{{ String(
      $json.failure_reason ||
      "Audit or email generation failed"
    ).replace(/\\/g, "\\\\").replace(/'/g, "''").replace(/\r?\n/g, " ") }}',

  status =
    CASE
      WHEN retry_count + 1 >=
        {{ $('config').first().json.maxRetries }}
      THEN 'audit_failed'
      ELSE 'enriched'
    END,

  updated_at = NOW()

WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}
  AND status = 'auditing'

RETURNING
  id,
  status,
  retry_count,
  failure_reason;

INSERT INTO public.workflow_logs (
  workflow_name,
  run_at,
  leads_processed,
  leads_failed,
  duration_ms,
  notes
)
VALUES (
  '{{ (
    $json.workflow_name ||
    "audit_and_draft"
  ).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',

  NOW(),

  {{ Number(
    $json.leads_processed
  ) || 0 }},

  {{ Number(
    $json.leads_failed
  ) || 0 }},

  {{ Number(
    $json.duration_ms
  ) || 0 }},

  '{{ (
    $json.notes ||
    "WF3 batch completed"
  ).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
)

RETURNING id;

WITH existing_draft AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.email_drafts
  WHERE lead_id = {{ $json.id }}
    AND status = 'draft'
  ORDER BY id DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE
),

updated_draft AS (
  UPDATE public.email_drafts
  SET
    subject =
      '{{ String($json.email_subject || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',

    body =
      '{{ String($json.email_body || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',

    updated_at = NOW()

  WHERE id = (
    SELECT id
    FROM existing_draft
  )

  RETURNING id
),

inserted_draft AS (
  INSERT INTO public.email_drafts (
    lead_id,
    subject,
    body,
    status,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )

  SELECT
    {{ $json.id }},

    '{{ String($json.email_subject || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',

    '{{ String($json.email_body || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',

    'draft',
    NOW(),
    NOW()

  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM existing_draft
  )

  RETURNING id
),

saved_draft AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM updated_draft

  UNION ALL

  SELECT id
  FROM inserted_draft
),

updated_lead AS (
  UPDATE public.leads
  SET
    status = 'pending_review',

    audit_summary =
      '{{ String($json.audit_summary || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',

    email_subject =
      '{{ String($json.email_subject || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',

    personalized_email =
      '{{ String($json.email_body || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',

    pagespeed_mobile =
      {{ $json.pagespeed_mobile
        ?? "NULL"
      }},

    pagespeed_desktop =
      {{ $json.pagespeed_desktop
        ?? "NULL"
      }},

    seo_score =
      {{ $json.seo_score
        ?? "NULL"
      }},

    website_pain_points =
      '{{ JSON.stringify(
        $json.website_pain_points || []
      ).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,

    social_pain_points =
      '{{ JSON.stringify(
        $json.social_pain_points || []
      ).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,

    retry_count = 0,
    failure_reason = NULL,
    audited_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW()

  WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}
    AND status = 'auditing'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM saved_draft
    )

  RETURNING id, status
)

SELECT
  saved_draft.id AS draft_id,
  updated_lead.id AS lead_id,
  updated_lead.status

FROM saved_draft
CROSS JOIN updated_lead;
